scope: Local native Swift macOS clients in independent processes; one configured authority Runtime at a time; GT and GemStone
limits: Existing single-listener connection ceiling is 64; Users feed policy permits at most 64 and defaults to 16. Qualification configured 64 feeds.
Latest-state semantics coalesce intermediate revisions; delivered-state latency is not a guarantee of delivery for every write.
Controlled close/reconnect on localhost; no abrupt process crash, lossy WAN, multi-host, Unreal or iOS load qualification in this run.
These workloads establish tested behavior and the local curve, not maximum production throughput or an SLO.
Client XCTest workers use debug Swift builds; these numbers are not release-client capacity measurements.
